summary: Columbus Circle Capital Corp III, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing that holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the Class A ordinary shares and redeemable warrants commencing July 31, 2026. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-third of one warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The announcement is an operational update regarding unit separation, not a special-situation event. It does not involve a business combination, restructuring, tender offer, or management change. The units will continue trading under CCCTU; separated shares and warrants will trade under CCCT and CCCTW, respectively. Holders must contact the transfer agent, Continental Stock Transfer Trust Company, to effect separation.
